about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer with 2+ years of experience building web and mobile apps for clients in many fields. I currently build AI-powered online store products, and I previously led a team of 6 developers as an Agile team lead.
about.p2: I'm a final-year software engineering student, looking for a PFE internship (end-of-studies internship).

points: Develop features for several client products at the same time, across backend, web and mobile.
Built online payments, live voice rooms for multiplayer games and player leaderboards for a membership app on web and mobile.
Built a store builder that lets members open their own online shop, with supplier stock updates, discount codes, refunds and payout approval.
Developed an AI assistant that edits a seller's online store from a chat, checking every change before saving it and allowing undo.
Built most of the backend for a creator selling platform, including seller balances, payouts and automated tests that run on every code change.
Built a Trello-style project management app (Java / Spring Boot backend) with boards, tasks, labels and custom workflow stages.
Added team invitations, role-based permissions and task assignment.
Built the company landing page and connected it to live activity data from the platform.
Created a Python tool that reads tables from images and turns them into structured data, in French and Arabic.
Led a team of 6 developers using Scrum, with sprint planning, reviews and code reviews.
Delivered DepoGro, a B2B ordering and delivery app released on the App Store and Google Play, along with its admin dashboard and server.
Built the phone login with SMS codes, user roles and order management, plus most of the mobile app screens in Arabic and French.
Delivered 10+ websites and apps for clients in car rental, device repair, healthcare and interior design.
Built a device repair booking app and its server from Figma designs, and helped deploy client projects on AWS.
